title: gguf-tdf/1 hybrid index
description: JSON Schema for the plaintext top-level `gguf` object in a gguf-tdf/1 OpenTDF manifest (spec draft-01 §9). Validate `manifest.gguf` against this schema. OpenTDF `payload` / `encryptionInformation` remain under the OpenTDF 4.3.0 schema. Invariants in spec §9.4–§9.5 (prefix-sum, zip 1:1, tensor coverage, header bind) are NOT expressible here and MUST be checked by the reader. Wire profile is unchanged from draft-00.

profile.description: Profile identifier. Readers MUST fail closed on any other value (§8.2).

alignment.description: GGUF ALIGN: general.alignment if present, else 32 (ggml docs/gguf.md). GGUF requires a multiple of 8. This profile additionally requires a power of two (§7.4); that check is the reader's, not this schema's.

headerBytes.description: Virtual offset of GGUF tensor_data (gguf_get_data_offset). MUST be a multiple of alignment (reader). Schema minimum 24 is GGUF v3 magic+version+tensor_count+kv_count; 24 is not a multiple of default ALIGN 32, so a value of 24 still fails the reader check unless alignment is 8.

virtualSize.description: Source GGUF file length in bytes. MUST be >= headerBytes.

maxSegment.description: Maximum plaintext size of a non-header segment. Default 4194304 (4 MiB). MUST be a multiple of alignment and >= alignment. Header plain MAY exceed this.

tensors.description: One entry per GGUF tensor, in GGUF file order. Empty only if tensor_count is 0.

segments.description: One entry per encrypted zip member, order header, s/1, … s/n. segments[0] MUST be the header. Same length and order as encryptionInformation.integrityInformation.segments. kind=header is locked to index 0 by the reader, not by this schema.

JsonUint53.description: Exact unsigned integer fitting in IEEE 754 JSON numbers (0 .. 2^53-1).

name.description: GGUF tensor name. JSON Schema maxLength is Unicode characters; ggml rejects names with length >= GGML_MAX_NAME (64), so the effective limit is 63 UTF-8 bytes. Readers MUST reject names whose UTF-8 byte length is greater than 63.

offset.description: Virtual file offset of the tensor data: headerBytes + GGUF tensor.offset. MUST be >= headerBytes (reader).

size.description: Tensor data size in bytes, excluding padding after the tensor.

segments.description: Half-open index range [start, end) into gguf.segments. start MUST be >= 1. end MUST be > start (so [1,1] is invalid). A tensor occupying only segment 5 is [5, 6].

id.description: MUST equal the array index (reader). Header is 0. Tensor/pack segments are 1..n.

kind.description: header: virtual [0, headerBytes), only at index 0 (reader). tensor: intersects exactly one tensor. pack: two or more tensors, or trailing/prior padding only.

plain.description: Plaintext size. MUST equal integrityInformation.segments[id].segmentSize. Non-header segments MUST have plain <= maxSegment. Packing MUST NOT emit a zero-length trailing segment.

entry.description: Zip member name. Header MUST be "header" (and kind MUST be header). Others MUST match s/[1-9][0-9]*. Cross-field kind/entry binding is a reader invariant.
